title: Grateful Dead Live at Onongada County War Memorial on 1982-04-08
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DRAGON => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit / 5.8 MHz Stereo] >> Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M > MAC. Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = Maxell UDXLII-S Analog

ai_review.summary: Fat, upfront audience tape captures a divisive Syracuse show highlighted by a strong Playing in the Band → Uncle John's Band segue.
ai_review.review: The Jim Vita audience recording is praised for its rich, forward‑focused sound that brings out the room’s energy. While some listeners love the Playin → UJB stretch and consider the tape a solid capture, others feel the performance itself was lackluster, making overall impressions mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently praised (good), but show performance receives both high and low marks, resulting in a mixed average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as very fat, upfront with strong presence; no major flaws noted, just typical audience tape ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance opinions are split – some enjoy the Playin → UJB transition, while others criticize overall energy and engagement.
